text: $PUMP surged 17.6% to $0.00583, flashing a high of $0.00601 before slipping back to $0.00468. $AAVE jumped 14.1% and is now $166.79, having swung between $145.29 and $176.28. Meanwhile $HBAR fell 14.5% to $0.10369, trading near its low of $0.10278 after peaking at $0.12463. The winners are ripping off double-digit gains, the loser is digging deep into the red. Nothing crazy, just a clear split between the few rockets and the one that got left behind.

$XRP's 24-hour swing sat at about 4.35%, well under its week-average 6.45%, that's roughly a third tighter than usual. It nudged up 0.35% to $1.5178, so the price stayed pretty flat inside that narrowed band.

$SOL moved just a hair, 3.67% range versus a typical 4.34%, basically on the same level as its normal volatility. It inched up 0.108% to $120.06, holding steady through the day.

$SUI's range was 9.57% against an 11.25% average, also close to its regular swing. It slipped 1.684% to $1.1792, staying within that expected window.

All three tokens kept their moves tight enough to stay within the usual limits, nothing wild on the charts.
